sql_schemas: table employees | fields: id, employee_number, first_name, last_name, email, manager_id, department, hire_date, termination_date, employment_status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at | pk: id | fks: manager_id -> employees.id | indexes: employee_number: unique lookup by employee number; email: unique lookup by email; manager_id: team hierarchy queries — list direct reports for manager approval workflows; employment_status: filter active/inactive/terminated employees for leave eligibility checks

table leave_types | fields: id, code, name, description, is_active, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | indexes: code: unique lookup by leave type code (annual, sick, emergency); is_active: filter active leave types for request forms and policy assignment

table leave_policies | fields: id, leave_type_id, policy_name, entitlement_days, accrual_rate, max_accumulation, minimum_notice_days, requires_manager_approval, is_active, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: leave_type_id -> leave_types.id | indexes: leave_type_id: join to leave type for policy lookups; is_active: filter active policies during leave request validation

table leave_requests | fields: id, employee_id, leave_type_id, start_date, end_date, reason, status, approved_by, approved_at, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employees.id; leave_type_id -> leave_types.id; approved_by -> employees.id | indexes: employee_id: list all leave requests for an employee (self-service dashboard); status: filter by status for approval queues (SUBMITTED) and reporting; leave_type_id: filter requests by leave type; start_date, end_date: date-range queries for calendar views and overlap detection; approved_by: list requests approved by a specific manager

table leave_balances | fields: id, employee_id, leave_type_id, policy_id, fiscal_year, total_entitlement, used_days, remaining_days, status, created_at, updated_at | pk: id | fks: employee_id -> employees.id; leave_type_id -> leave_types.id; policy_id -> leave_policies.id | indexes: employee_id: look up balances for a specific employee (self-service dashboard); employee_id, leave_type_id, fiscal_year: unique composite lookup — one balance row per employee per leave type per fiscal year; leave_type_id: aggregate balance queries by leave type; fiscal_year: filter balances by fiscal year for accrual and reset jobs

data_notes: Persistence slice for leave management feature. Five conceptual tables defined: employees (referenced by leave_requests, leave_balances, and self-referencing manager_id), leave_types (lookup table for annual/sick/emergency), leave_policies (per-type entitlement rules), leave_requests (the core leave application entity with status lifecycle), and leave_balances (per-employee per-type per-fiscal-year tracking). Five repository interfaces with concrete Pg* implementations backed by PostgreSQL via the existing pg Pool at src/shared/db/connection.ts. All state-changing operations on leave_requests and leave_balances must produce audit records per GP-002. The leave_requests.status field drives the approval workflow (DRAFT → SUBMITTED → APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED). Overlap detection is handled via the findOverlapping repository method. Balance deduction happens on approval; balance restoration on rejection/cancellation.
